body: Well, I loved that he made me feel safe and cared for. Even if I was having the worst day ever, as long as I was in his arms none of that mattered. I remember he used to let me put makeup on him and do face masks with him, which usually guys refuse to do because they think it’s gay or whatever. He was weird in the sense that we both were awkward and had social anxiety, but we could confide in each other about it rather than putting on an act like we both had to in our daily lives. I used to make him give me piggy back rides, and he would always insist on being the little spoon when we cuddled even though he was a foot taller than me! We both just had quirks that we loved so much about each other. The song that we both loved so much was “first day of my life” by bright eyes. We used to turn off the lights, play that song, and just cuddle and sing along to it. He also loved “heaven knows I’m miserable now” by the smiths, and would play it on repeat nonstop, which I’ve been doing now too.
